title: docs + skills: teach that a deleted seed row stays deleted (#31021), and fix the stale seed-mode table in the objectstack-data skill
body:
domain:server#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcTJTE7kSbcMoJQ4Txf

Filing-gate category: ① a named-location documentation defect, owed as the `Skills-docs:` follow-up of PR #31083 (#31021).

## Why (business)

An author or an AI agent learns how seeds behave from these two pages. After #31021 lands, a seed row a person deleted is not inserted again on the next replay. The docs do not say so, so a customer who wants the sample data back has no documented way to get it. Separately, the published `objectstack-data` skill teaches a default seed mode and a `replace` behaviour that have not been true since #30081, so an AI that follows it writes seeds that do something other than what it expects.

## Items (two lanes; triage routes or splits)

1. **`content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx`**: teach the landed-keys rule from PR #31083. Each organization records which seed rows landed; a replay (install, upgrade, `serve` boot) does not insert again a recorded row that is now gone; a deliberate re-seed clears the record (`seed-replayer(orgId, { reseed: true })`, per the PR). Source: the PR #31083 changeset and body. The page already describes `ignore` as the default correctly (`:74`, `:80`).
2. **`skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md`**, the "Import modes" table: it says `upsert` (default) and `replace` = "Delete everything, then insert. **Data loss.**" On `main`, `ignore` is the default (#30081, and `seed-data.mdx:74`), and `replace` deletes nothing (`seed-data.mdx:78`: "the seed loader does **not** delete anything itself"). Align the table with the docs page and the loader. A skills line budget applies.

Reader: item 1 is docs (`content/docs/**`); item 2 is the published skills (`skills/**`). Item 1 waits for PR #31083 to merge.

Blocked-by: #31021

Dedupe (2026-11-07): `seed-data.mdx deleted seed row` → 10, `seeds.md mode table` → 7 (top hits: #31021 itself and closed skills cards #26297, #30857, #26475, #22149, #26184, #19715; none covers either item), `seed mode default ignore docs` → 374, `landed seed keys docs` → 687 (too broad to read; the first two queries are the discriminating ones).
